ja.risks: 広告市況、Cookieや端末IDの制限、広告在庫・データ会社への依存、大口代理店の集中、巨大広告基盤との競争が弱点。
ja.competition: 広告主や代理店が広告枠を買い付けるDSPでは、AlphabetのGoogle事業とAmazonが競合例。The Trade Desk自身が実名を挙げている。Googleは広告在庫の供給元でもあり、買い付け基盤での競争と在庫調達の関係は両立する。
ja.relationships: 広告主と代理店が買い手となり、媒体社・広告取引所から広告枠を調達し、データ・測定会社と連携する。 2025年9月の自社記事はSpotify Ad Exchangeの音声・動画広告在庫をThe Trade Deskから購入できると説明。媒体在庫への接続・広告販売協業で、Spotifyの全音楽データ提供や計算容量購入ではない。

en.business: A demand-side platform used by advertisers and agencies to buy and measure connected-TV, video, audio and display ads programmatically.
en.revenue: Charges platform fees tied to advertising spend placed through the system, with additional fees for data and related features.
en.strength: Independence from owned media, access across many inventory sources, and data, measurement and optimization technology are advantages.
en.risks: Ad cycles, cookie and device-ID restrictions, inventory and data dependencies, agency concentration and competition from large platforms are risks.
en.competition: The Trade Desk explicitly names Google and Amazon as demand-side advertising-platform competitors. The overlap concerns advertiser/agency buying tools. Google is also an advertising-inventory supplier in its filing, so platform competition and inventory sourcing can coexist.
en.relationships: Advertisers and agencies are buyers, publishers and exchanges provide inventory, and data and measurement vendors support targeting and results. Its September 2025 article describes access to Spotify Ad Exchange audio / video inventory through The Trade Desk. This is publisher-inventory integration and advertising collaboration, without implying access to all music data or computing-capacity purchases.

ja.business: 飲食店、小売店、買い物客、配達員を結び、料理や日用品を注文・配送する地域商取引プラットフォーム。
ja.revenue: 加盟店手数料、利用者の配達・サービス料、DashPass会費、加盟店やブランド向け広告から稼ぐ。
ja.strength: 加盟店、注文者、配達員が互いを増やす地域密度、配達技術、飲食以外へ広がる品ぞろえが強い。
ja.risks: 配達員の雇用区分規制、保険と事故、配送品質、販促費、加盟店・利用者・配達員の離脱が利益を左右する。
ja.competition: 料理配達ではUber Eats、食品・日用品の配送ではAmazon、Instacart、Walmartが競合例。Uber・AmazonはDoorDash自身の実名開示、Instacart・Walmartは公式サービスとDoorDashの対象分野を比較した編集上の例。加盟店の直接注文・自社配送や店頭購入も代替で、地域や品ぞろえ、配送体制は各社で異なる。
ja.relationships: 加盟店が商品を供給し、配達員が注文を運び、利用者が購入する。加盟店やブランドには広告枠も販売する。 2026年5月に米国Kroger系列約2,700店でSNAP / EBTを使う食料品配達決済を開始。7月には米国に実店舗を持つShopify加盟店向け販売チャネル連携を開始した。海外展開計画や期限付き配達料優遇を恒久・全地域の条件とは扱わない。

en.business: A local-commerce platform connecting restaurants, retailers, consumers and couriers to order and deliver meals and everyday goods.
en.revenue: Earns merchant commissions, consumer delivery and service fees, DashPass subscriptions, and advertising from merchants and brands.
en.strength: Local density across merchants, consumers and Dashers, logistics technology, and expansion beyond restaurants reinforce the network.
en.risks: Courier-classification rules, insurance and safety, delivery quality, promotions, and retention of merchants, consumers and Dashers affect profits.
en.competition: Uber Eats in meal delivery and Amazon, Instacart and Walmart in grocery/everyday delivery are examples. DoorDash names Uber and Amazon; Instacart and Walmart are editorial comparisons of official services with DoorDash scope. Direct merchant ordering, merchant fleets and in-store shopping remain alternatives. Geography, selection and delivery models differ.
en.relationships: Merchants supply goods, Dashers deliver orders, consumers purchase them, and merchants and brands also buy advertising inventory. In May 2026 it launched SNAP / EBT grocery-delivery payments at nearly 2,700 US Kroger-family stores. July brought a Shopify sales channel for merchants with US physical stores. Planned international expansion and temporary fee promotions are not assumed permanent or worldwide.

ja.relationships: 販売事業者が商品を出品し、買い手が購入する。加盟店・利用者には決済、口座、融資を提供し、配送網と連携する。 Mercado Pagoのメキシコ公式商品ページはVisa対応クレジットカードを明記。メキシコの商品・決済ネットワークの関係であり、他国の全決済やVisaによる出資を示さない。

en.business: A Latin American commerce and financial-services company combining a marketplace, payments, digital accounts, logistics, ads and credit.
en.revenue: Earns marketplace fees, shipping and advertising revenue, payment-processing fees and credit interest across commerce and Mercado Pago.
en.strength: A regional network linking buyers, sellers, payments, logistics and credit, supported by locally built infrastructure, is the core advantage.
en.risks: Currency and inflation, country regulation, credit losses, logistics costs, fraud and competition across both commerce and finance are risks.
en.competition: Commerce examples are Amazon and Sea’s Shopee in Brazil. In financial services, Nu/Nubank accounts, cards and lending in Brazil, Mexico and Colombia overlap selected Mercado Pago offerings. These are editorial comparisons of official local services, not an assertion of identical coverage across Latin America or that MercadoLibre explicitly names these companies.
en.relationships: Sellers list goods and buyers purchase them; merchants and consumers also use payments, accounts and credit connected to logistics networks. Mercado Pago’s official Mexico product page identifies its Visa-backed credit card. This establishes a Mexico product / payment-network relationship, without implying all payments in other countries or a Visa equity investment.

ja.business: PayPalとVenmoを中心に、個人と事業者のオンライン・店頭決済、送金、請求、信用をつなぐ決済基盤。
ja.revenue: 決済額と取引件数に応じた手数料が中心で、融資、即時出金、為替などの付加サービスでも稼ぐ。
ja.strength: 買い手と売り手の二面ネットワーク、決済データ、不正検知、複数の資金源を一つにつなぐチェックアウトが強い。
ja.risks: 不正・取引損失、規制、加盟店価格、ブランド決済の競争、カード網・銀行・処理会社への依存が利益を左右する。
ja.competition: デジタル財布・オンライン支払いではApple Pay、加盟店向け決済処理ではStripe、Venmoの送金や加盟店決済ではBlockのCash App・Square、後払いではAffirmが競合例。各社の公表製品を照合した編集上の比較で、PayPal自身の実名列挙ではない。決済手段として相互利用できる場合もある。
ja.relationships: 個人が支払い・送金し、加盟店が代金を受け取る。銀行、カード網、処理会社が入出金と決済を支える。 2025年10月、OpenAIのInstant CheckoutとACPに対応する決済提携を発表し、加盟店商品カタログの展開は2026年計画と説明。PayPalの決済処理とChatGPT Enterprise / Codex利用は異なる用途で、全加盟店の提供開始やAI計算容量購入とは扱わない。

en.business: A payments platform centered on PayPal and Venmo that connects consumers and merchants across checkout, transfers, invoicing and credit.
en.revenue: Earns mainly transaction fees tied to payment volume and activity, plus credit, instant transfer, foreign-exchange and other services.
en.strength: A two-sided buyer-seller network, payment data, fraud controls and checkout across multiple funding sources are key advantages.
en.risks: Fraud and transaction losses, regulation, merchant pricing, branded-checkout competition and dependence on banks and card networks are risks.
en.competition: Examples include Apple Pay in wallet/online checkout, Stripe in merchant processing, Block’s Cash App/Square in P2P and merchant payments, and Affirm in BNPL. These are editorial comparisons of disclosed products, not PayPal’s explicit named list. Payment providers may also support one another’s methods.
en.relationships: Consumers pay and transfer funds, merchants receive payments, and banks, card networks and processors support money movement and settlement. Its October 2025 OpenAI partnership covers Instant Checkout / ACP payments, with merchant catalogs planned for 2026. Payment processing and internal ChatGPT Enterprise / Codex use have different roles; completed rollout to every merchant and AI capacity purchases are not inferred.

ja.business: Squareで事業者の決済・業務を、Cash Appで個人の送金・カード・貯蓄・投資を支える金融技術企業。
ja.revenue: 加盟店決済と業務ソフト、Cash Appの即時送金・カード・金融商品、BNPL、ビットコイン取引などから稼ぐ。
ja.strength: 決済端末からソフト・融資まで揃うSquareと、日常金融を集約するCash Appの二つの生態系と取引データが強い。
ja.risks: 不正・貸倒れ、金融規制、銀行・カード網への依存、激しい決済競争、ビットコイン価格と取引量の変動が弱点。
ja.competition: Squareの店舗POSではShopify POS、Cash Appの送金や加盟店決済ではPayPal・Venmo、Afterpayの後払いではAffirmが競合例。ShopifyのSquare比較と各社の公表製品を照合しており、送金、店舗運営、後払いを同じ市場として扱わない。
ja.relationships: 事業者がSquareで販売・決済し、個人がCash Appを使う。銀行、カード網、処理会社が決済と口座機能を支える。 Squareの米国公式サポートは、対象Squareプランと飲食店POSモードでDoorDash注文・メニュー・営業時間等を同期できると説明。製品連携であり、DoorDash自身を加盟飲食店顧客とみなしたり、全プラン・全地域に一般化しない。

en.business: A financial-technology company serving sellers through Square and consumers through Cash App transfers, cards, savings and investing.
en.revenue: Earns from merchant payments and software, Cash App transfers, cards and financial products, BNPL and bitcoin transactions.
en.strength: Square's integrated hardware, software and finance plus Cash App's consumer ecosystem and first-party transaction data are advantages.
en.risks: Fraud and credit losses, financial regulation, bank and card-network dependence, intense payments competition and bitcoin volatility are risks.
en.competition: Examples include Shopify POS versus Square, PayPal/Venmo versus Cash App and merchant payments, and Affirm versus Afterpay BNPL. Shopify’s Square comparison and official product descriptions support these scoped examples. Retail operations, P2P and installment lending are separate product areas.
en.relationships: Sellers use Square and consumers use Cash App, while banks, card networks and processors support payments and account functions. Square’s US support page describes DoorDash order, menu and opening-hours integration for eligible plans and restaurant POS modes. This is product integration; DoorDash is not inferred to be a restaurant merchant customer, and availability is not generalized to all plans or countries.

ja.revenue: Super DuolingoとDuolingo Maxの月額・年額契約が中心で、広告、アプリ内購入、英語試験でも稼ぐ。
ja.strength: 無料で始められる導線、習慣化を促すゲーム設計、学習データを使う個別最適化、強いブランドが成長を支える。
ja.risks: 学習継続と有料化、AIによる競争と内容品質、Apple・Googleへの配信依存、個人情報・未成年者対応が弱点。
ja.competition: 語学アプリではBabbel、AI会話練習ではSpeakeasy LabsのSpeak、英語力試験ではPearsonのPTE AcademicとETSのTOEFL iBTが比較例。各社の公式サービスとDuolingoの対象分野を照合した編集上の競合例。学習アプリと試験を分け、試験の採用校・用途や受験方式が同じとはしない。
ja.relationships: 学習者と有料会員へ教材を提供し、学校・大学は英語試験を受け入れ、アプリ配信基盤が契約決済を担う。 2023年3月の自社発表で、OpenAI GPT-4を使うDuolingo Maxを対象市場のiOS向けに提供。時点を限定した製品採用であり、当時のモデル・機能・対応市場が現在も全て同じとは扱わない。

en.business: A mobile and web learning service offering game-like language, math, music and chess courses plus an English proficiency test.
en.revenue: Earns mainly Super Duolingo and Duolingo Max subscriptions, with additional ads, in-app purchases and English Test revenue.
en.strength: A free entry point, habit-forming game design, data-driven personalization and a strong brand support growth and conversion.
en.risks: Learner retention and paid conversion, AI competition and content quality, Apple and Google dependence, privacy and youth safety are risks.
en.competition: Language-learning examples include Babbel and Speakeasy Labs’ Speak AI conversation tutor. English-assessment examples are Pearson PTE Academic and ETS TOEFL iBT. These are editorial comparisons of official services with Duolingo’s scope, not a company-named list. Learning apps and tests differ, including acceptance, purposes and delivery methods.
en.relationships: Learners and subscribers use courses, schools and universities recognize the English Test, and app platforms handle distribution and billing. Its March 2023 release identifies OpenAI GPT-4 in Duolingo Max for iOS in selected markets. This is dated product adoption, without assuming every original model, feature or market remains unchanged today.

ja.business: 半導体の欠陥を見つけ、寸法や位置ずれを測る検査・計測装置と解析ソフトを作る会社。先端パッケージや特殊半導体にも対応する。
ja.revenue: 半導体メーカーや組立・検査会社への装置販売に加え、ソフト、保守、交換部品で稼ぐ。
ja.strength: 光学検査、計測、工程データ解析を一体で提供できる。微細化だけでなく、複数チップを組み合わせる先端パッケージにも強い。
ja.risks: 半導体設備投資の波、大口顧客の発注、輸出規制の影響を受ける。新装置の認定遅れや部品不足も売上時期を動かす。
ja.competition: 半導体の検査・計測ではKLA、寸法や薄膜などの計測ではNovaが競合例。両社の年次報告はOnto Innovationを実名で挙げている。欠陥検査、膜厚・寸法計測、先端パッケージなどで比較する装置や用途は異なる。
ja.relationships: 半導体工場と組立・検査会社へ装置とソフトを供給し、稼働後は保守や部品交換で量産を支える。 SK hynixとのHBM生産向けDragonfly G5検査協力は2026年10月の自社発表で確認。TSMCも2025年11月にOntoの生産支援を供給者表彰した。表彰対象の関係を示し、特定装置の購入数量は未開示。

en.business: Makes inspection and metrology tools and analytics software that find defects and measure dimensions and overlay in semiconductor production, including advanced packaging and specialty devices.
en.revenue: Earns from system sales to chipmakers and assembly-and-test providers, plus software, service and replacement parts.
en.strength: Combines optical inspection, metrology and process-data analytics, serving both device scaling and multi-chip advanced packaging.
en.risks: Semiconductor spending cycles, large-customer orders and export controls affect demand; qualification delays and component shortages can shift revenue timing.
en.competition: Examples include KLA in semiconductor inspection and metrology, and Nova in critical-dimension and thin-film metrology. Both explicitly name Onto Innovation in annual filings. Defect inspection, dimensional measurement and packaging applications have different equipment requirements.
en.relationships: Supplies tools and software to wafer fabs and assembly-and-test providers, then supports production through service and replacement parts. An October 2026 company release confirms Dragonfly G5 inspection collaboration with SK hynix in HBM production. TSMC recognized Onto production support in November 2025. These awards establish the disclosed relationships without individual tool purchase volumes.

ja.business: 出荷前の半導体や電子部品を自動で検査する装置を作る会社。協働ロボットと自律搬送ロボットも手がける。
ja.revenue: 半導体・製品テスト装置と保守、Universal Robotsの協働ロボット、MiRの搬送ロボットの販売で稼ぐ。
ja.strength: 複雑なSoCやメモリーを高速に大量検査する装置、長年の導入実績、世界各地の技術支援が強み。ロボットは扱いやすさを重視する。
ja.risks: 半導体の新製品投入と設備投資に売上が左右され、大口顧客への集中もある。ロボット需要の弱さや部品供給、輸出規制も負担になる。
ja.competition: 半導体テスターではAdvantestとCohu、製品試験ではKeysight、ロボットでは協働アームのDoosan Roboticsや自律搬送のOmronが競合例。いずれもTeradyne自身の年次報告に実名がある。半導体、電子機器の試験、工場の搬送では比較する製品が異なる。
ja.relationships: 半導体メーカーや受託組立・検査会社へテスト装置を供給し、工場や物流現場へ協働・搬送ロボットを販売する。 FY2025年次報告書では、FlexにマレーシアでFLEX・J750の製造と試験を委託。Plexusにはマレーシア・タイでFLEX・Magnum、マレーシアでETSを委託する。FLEXはテスト装置の商品名でもあり、供給企業Flexと区別する。

en.business: Builds automated equipment that tests semiconductors and electronic products before shipment, and also sells collaborative and autonomous mobile robots.
en.revenue: Earns from semiconductor and product-test systems and service, Universal Robots cobots and MiR mobile robots.
en.strength: Combines high-throughput testing for complex SoCs and memory with a large installed base and global support; its robots emphasize ease of deployment.
en.risks: Revenue depends on semiconductor launches and capital spending and is concentrated among major customers; weak robotics demand, component supply and export controls add risk.
en.competition: Teradyne names Advantest and Cohu in semiconductor test, Keysight in product test, Doosan Robotics in collaborative arms and Omron in autonomous mobile robots. These are separate test and automation applications.
en.relationships: Supplies testers to chipmakers and outsourced assembly-and-test providers, and sells collaborative and mobile robots into factories and logistics sites. Its FY2025 annual report identifies Flex manufacturing and testing FLEX / J750 in Malaysia, and Plexus manufacturing and testing FLEX / Magnum in Malaysia and Thailand and ETS in Malaysia. The FLEX system brand is distinct from supplier Flex.

ja.business: 半導体工場で使う超高純度の材料、フィルター、薬液・ガス搬送部品を作り、微小な汚染から製造工程を守る会社。
ja.revenue: 工場で繰り返し交換される材料・フィルター・容器と、流体管理システムを半導体メーカーや装置会社へ販売して稼ぐ。
ja.strength: 材料科学、ろ過、流体管理を幅広く持ち、顧客の工程開発段階から品質と純度を作り込める。消耗品が継続収益につながる。
ja.risks: 半導体生産量と設備投資の波、顧客集中、原材料不足、輸出規制の影響を受ける。買収で増えた負債と事業統合も負担。
ja.competition: Entegris自身は部門別に競合を開示する。Pall（Danaher傘下）は高純度化ソリューション、Merck KGaAのEMD Performance Materialsは材料分野の比較対象。Merck KGaAは米国製薬会社Merck & Co.とは別企業。ろ過・材料・搬送の全製品を互換とせず、製品別に範囲が異なる。
ja.relationships: 半導体工場と製造装置メーカーへ材料、フィルター、搬送部品を供給し、量産工程の汚染管理を支える。 FY2025自社開示ではTSMCが売上の16%を占める。半導体材料や汚染管理製品等の顧客であり、顧客別の全製品内訳や将来の最低発注量を示すものではない。

en.business: Makes ultra-pure materials, filters and chemical-and-gas delivery components that protect semiconductor processes from microscopic contamination.
en.revenue: Sells recurring materials, filters and containers plus fluid-management systems to chipmakers and equipment manufacturers.
en.strength: Its breadth across materials science, filtration and fluid management lets it work with customers during process development; consumables create recurring demand.
en.risks: Semiconductor output and capital cycles, customer concentration, raw-material constraints and export controls affect results; acquisition debt and integration add pressure.
en.competition: Entegris names competitors by segment. Pall, part of Danaher, is an Advanced Purity Solutions peer; Merck KGaA EMD Performance Materials is a Materials Solutions peer. Merck KGaA is distinct from US Merck & Co. Filtration, materials and handling portfolios are not interchangeable across all products.
en.relationships: Supplies materials, filters and delivery components to wafer fabs and equipment makers, supporting contamination control in volume production. TSMC represented 16% of FY2025 sales, according to company disclosure. This identifies a customer for semiconductor materials and contamination-control products, without a complete customer-specific product split or minimum future orders.

ja.business: 半導体ウエハーを薬液で洗う装置を中心に、めっき、炉、パッケージ工程用装置まで作る会社。事業の中心は中国子会社。
ja.revenue: 半導体メーカーへの製造装置販売と、設置後の部品・保守サービスで稼ぐ。洗浄装置が主力で、工程範囲を広げている。
ja.strength: 複数枚のウエハーを効率よく洗う独自技術と、中国の顧客に近い開発・サービス体制。洗浄以外の工程へ製品を広げられる。
ja.risks: 売上と資産が中国に大きく集中し、米中規制、監査・上場制度、輸出管理の影響を受ける。顧客集中と新装置の認定も課題。
ja.competition: ウエハー洗浄・めっきなどの工程装置ではLam Research、SCREEN、炉装置などではKokusai Semiconductor Equipment、PECVD成膜ではApplied Materialsが競合例。ACM自身の年次報告に実名がある。洗浄、めっき、熱処理、成膜では装置の役割が異なる。
ja.relationships: 主に中国の半導体工場へ洗浄・めっき・熱処理装置を供給し、部品会社から精密機器や材料を調達する。

en.business: Builds semiconductor wafer-cleaning equipment and is expanding into electroplating, furnace and packaging-process tools, with operations centered on its China subsidiary.
en.revenue: Earns from equipment sales to chipmakers and post-installation parts and service; cleaning remains the core while the process portfolio expands.
en.strength: Combines proprietary multi-wafer cleaning technology with engineering and support close to Chinese customers, and can extend into adjacent process steps.
en.risks: Revenue and assets are heavily concentrated in China, exposing the company to U.S.-China rules, audit and listing issues and export controls; customer concentration and tool qualification also matter.
en.competition: ACM names Lam Research, SCREEN and Kokusai Semiconductor Equipment among rivals across cleaning, plating and furnace equipment, and Applied Materials in PECVD. These are distinct process-tool categories rather than interchangeable products.
en.relationships: Primarily supplies cleaning, plating and thermal-process tools to Chinese fabs and purchases precision components and materials from suppliers.

ja.business: 半導体製造装置の中でガスや薬液を正確に送る流体システムと、超高純度の溶接・精密部品を作る会社。
ja.revenue: 大手半導体装置メーカー向けに、設計済みの流体供給サブシステム、部品、精密加工品を販売して稼ぐ。
ja.strength: 顧客装置に合わせた設計、厳しい清浄度管理、精密溶接と量産対応を一体で提供する。認定に時間がかかるため継続採用されやすい。
ja.risks: 売上が少数の装置メーカーに大きく集中し、その生産計画と半導体設備投資に左右される。品質問題や部品不足も影響が大きい。
ja.competition: 流体供給サブシステムではUltra Clean、半導体装置向け精密加工ではBenchmark Electronicsが競合例。Ultra CleanはIchor自身の開示、Benchmarkは両社の公表する加工サービスの比較。ガス・薬液供給と精密加工は別の製品・工程として見る。
ja.relationships: 半導体装置メーカーへ組み込まれる流体システムと部品を供給し、精密加工・材料の仕入先から部材を調達する。 FY2025の自社年次報告書はLam Research、Applied Materials、ASMLを主要OEM顧客として明記。流体供給システムや精密部品の関係で、将来の最低発注数量を保証するものではない。

en.business: Makes gas-and-chemical delivery subsystems, ultra-high-purity weldments and precision components built into semiconductor manufacturing equipment.
en.revenue: Sells engineered fluid-delivery subsystems, components and precision-machined products to major semiconductor equipment makers.
en.strength: Combines customer-specific design, stringent purity control, precision welding and volume manufacturing; lengthy qualification can support recurring programs.
en.risks: Revenue is highly concentrated among a few equipment customers and follows their production plans and semiconductor capital spending; quality issues and component shortages can have outsized effects.
en.competition: Examples include Ultra Clean in fluid-delivery subsystems and Benchmark Electronics in semiconductor-equipment precision machining. Ichor explicitly names Ultra Clean; Benchmark is an editorial comparison of disclosed machining services. Fluid delivery and machining are distinct scopes.
en.relationships: Supplies fluid systems and components integrated into wafer-fab equipment and sources materials and precision parts from its supplier base. Its FY2025 annual report names Lam Research, Applied Materials and ASML as major OEM customers for fluid-delivery systems and precision components. This does not guarantee minimum future order volumes.

ja.business: 半導体製造装置向けの複雑なサブシステムや部品を組み立て、使用済み部品の超高純度洗浄と分析も行う会社。
ja.revenue: 装置メーカー向けの製品部門と、部品洗浄・コーティング・分析などのサービス部門で稼ぐ。
ja.strength: 複雑な装置モジュールを世界各地で量産し、洗浄・再生・分析まで一社で扱える。顧客の生産拠点近くで支援できる。
ja.risks: 少数の大手装置顧客への依存、半導体設備投資の変動、急な増減産、品質管理、世界各地の供給網がリスク。
ja.competition: ガス供給ではIchorとFujikin、装置サブシステムではBenchmark Electronics、部品の洗浄・コーティングではEnproが競合例。Ultra Clean自身が製品分野ごとに実名を挙げている。供給装置、加工部品、洗浄サービスを同じものとして比較しない。
ja.relationships: 半導体装置メーカーへ組立済みサブシステムを供給し、装置会社や半導体工場から部品を預かって洗浄・分析する。 FY2025の自社年次報告書でApplied MaterialsとLam Researchを最大の2顧客と開示し、各社への売上はそれぞれ全体の10%超。装置向けサブシステム等の供給関係であり、顧客の全製品を独占供給する意味ではない。

en.business: Builds complex subsystems and components for semiconductor equipment and provides ultra-high-purity cleaning and analysis for used parts.
en.revenue: Earns through a Products segment serving equipment makers and a Services segment covering cleaning, coating and analytical work.
en.strength: Combines global manufacturing of complex modules with cleaning, refurbishment and analysis close to customers' production locations.
en.risks: Dependence on a few large equipment customers, semiconductor capital cycles, rapid production changes, quality execution and a global supply chain create risk.
en.competition: Ultra Clean names Ichor and Fujikin in gas delivery, Benchmark Electronics in critical subsystems, and Enpro in cleaning and coating services. Delivery systems, manufactured components and refurbishment services have different functions.
en.relationships: Supplies assembled subsystems to equipment manufacturers and receives parts from equipment companies and fabs for cleaning and analysis. Its FY2025 annual report identifies Applied Materials and Lam Research as its two largest customers, each above 10% of revenue. The equipment-subsystem relationship does not establish exclusive supply across all customer products.

en.revenue: Earns from equipment components, lasers, optical products, electronic materials and chemicals plus service and consumables across semiconductor and industrial markets.
en.strength: Spans vacuum control, photonics, lasers and materials processing with a large installed base, covering both critical tool components and manufacturing materials.
en.risks: Semiconductor and industrial investment cycles, acquisition integration and debt, customer concentration, supply constraints and export controls affect results.
en.competition: MKS names Advanced Energy in power and plasma products, INFICON in pressure and vacuum control, Coherent and Lumentum in laser/photonics products, and Element Solutions in chemistry. These are product-specific examples rather than one company competing across the entire portfolio.
en.relationships: Supplies critical components, light sources and materials to equipment makers, wafer fabs, circuit-board manufacturers and industrial companies.

ja.business: 電波の送受信に使うRF・アナログ半導体を作る会社。2026年10月5日にQorvoとの統合を完了し、車載・産業・防衛などへ製品範囲を広げた。
ja.revenue: 端末メーカーや通信・車載・産業機器会社へ、RFフロントエンド、増幅器、フィルター、接続用チップを販売して稼ぐ。
ja.strength: 複数の無線部品を小型モジュールへまとめる設計力と製造技術、端末メーカーでの長い認定実績が強み。
ja.risks: スマートフォンと大口顧客への依存が大きく、機種変更や販売不振が直撃する。価格競争、在庫調整、中国需要、製造歩留まりも影響する。Qorvo事業の統合負担や買収資金の負債も確認が必要。
ja.competition: 携帯・Wi-Fi向けのRFモジュールやフィルターではBroadcom、Qualcomm、村田製作所が競合例。統合前の実名開示と公式製品を照合した。Qorvoとは2026年10月5日に統合を完了しており、現在の独立した競合としては扱わない。
ja.relationships: スマートフォン、通信機器、自動車、産業機器メーカーへ無線・アナログ部品を供給し、外部の製造・組立会社も利用する。 FY2025の自社開示ではApple向けが売上の67%。代理店・製造受託会社を経由する販売と直接販売の合計で、Appleへの直接請求だけの比率ではない。2025年10月3日期の統合前Skyworksの数値であり、Qorvo統合後の現在の合算売上比率に置き換えない。

en.business: Makes RF and analog semiconductors for wireless signals. Completed the Qorvo combination on October 5, 2026, broadening its automotive, industrial and defense portfolio.
en.revenue: Sells RF front-end modules, amplifiers, filters and connectivity chips to device, communications, automotive and industrial manufacturers.
en.strength: Combines multiple radio functions in compact modules, backed by manufacturing know-how and long qualification histories with device makers.
en.risks: Heavy smartphone and major-customer exposure makes model changes and weak sell-through important; pricing, inventory corrections, China demand and manufacturing yields also matter. Qorvo integration and acquisition financing add execution and debt risks.
en.competition: Broadcom, Qualcomm and Murata are examples in mobile/Wi-Fi RF modules and filters, checked against pre-combination named disclosures and official products. The Qorvo combination closed on October 5, 2026; Qorvo is no longer presented as an independent rival.
en.relationships: Supplies wireless and analog components to smartphone, network, automotive and industrial manufacturers and also uses external manufacturing and assembly providers. Its FY2025 filing attributes 67% of revenue to Apple, combining distributor, contract-manufacturer and direct sales. This is not a direct-billing-only share. The figure covers pre-combination Skyworks for the year ended October 3, 2025, rather than the current combined Skyworks/Qorvo business.

ja.business: 光通信、データセンター、通信、防衛で使う高周波・アナログ半導体を作る会社。RF、マイクロ波、光部品を扱う。
ja.revenue: 通信・クラウド機器、防衛、産業機器メーカーへ、増幅器、レーザー・光検出器、ダイオード、GaN製品を販売して稼ぐ。
ja.strength: 高速光通信と高周波RFを横断し、化合物半導体、シリコン、フォトニクスを用途に合わせて使い分けられる。
ja.risks: 通信・データセンター投資の波、輸出規制、顧客と製品の集中、外部工場の供給、買収統合、防衛案件の時期が業績を動かす。
ja.competition: MACOM自身はAnalog Devices・Broadcom・Marvell・Skyworksなどを競合に挙げる。比較分野はRF・マイクロ波・光通信用の高性能アナログ半導体で、全社の全製品が同等ではない。旧Qorvoは2026年10月5日にSkyworksとの統合が完了しており、現行の独立上場競合として重複表示しない。顧客の内製設計も代替になる。
ja.relationships: データセンター・通信機器会社と防衛・産業顧客へ半導体を供給し、外部工場や組立会社へ製造を委託する。 2026年2月、SemtechとACC-MSAの共同議長を務め、リニア・イコライザーを使う銅接続の電気・ファームウェア・試験仕様の策定を発表。規格協力であり、加盟全社との個別売買や出資を意味しない。

en.business: Makes high-frequency and analog semiconductors for optical networking, data centers, telecom, defense and industrial systems across RF, microwave and photonics.
en.revenue: Sells amplifiers, lasers and photodetectors, diodes and GaN products to communications, cloud-equipment, defense and industrial manufacturers.
en.strength: Spans high-speed optical and RF technologies and can apply compound semiconductors, silicon and photonics to different performance needs.
en.risks: Communications and data-center spending cycles, export controls, customer and product concentration, foundry supply, acquisition integration and defense-program timing affect results.
en.competition: MACOM names Analog Devices, Broadcom, Marvell and Skyworks among its competitors in RF, microwave and photonic analog semiconductors. Entire portfolios are not equivalent. Qorvo completed its combination with Skyworks on October 5, 2026 and is not duplicated as a currently independent listed peer. Customer in-house design remains an alternative.
en.relationships: Supplies chips to data-center and communications-equipment makers and defense and industrial customers, while outsourcing portions of fabrication and assembly. In February 2026 MACOM and Semtech announced co-chairing ACC-MSA to define electrical, firmware and test specifications for copper interconnects with linear equalizers. Standards work does not establish purchases or investments between every consortium member.

ja.revenue: 家電、充電器、産業機器、再生可能エネルギー、車載向けに、電源変換ICとドライバー製品を販売して稼ぐ。
ja.strength: 高耐圧スイッチと制御回路を一つにまとめ、部品点数、電力損失、設計時間を減らせる。設計支援と省エネ性能も強み。
ja.risks: 家電・消費者機器の需要、流通在庫、中国市場と競争、外部工場の供給に左右される。代替部品の値下がりも価格圧力になる。
ja.competition: Power Integrations自身の開示では、高電圧電源ICにSTMicroelectronics・Infineon、PWM制御ICにNXP・Texas Instrumentsなどが競合する。onsemiはモーター駆動用パワーモジュールで比較する。GaN、ゲートドライバー、制御ICは役割が異なり、個別部品を組み合わせた設計も代替になる。
ja.relationships: 家電・産業・自動車の電源メーカーへ製品を直接または販売会社経由で供給し、外部工場と組立・検査会社へ製造を委託する。 2026年6月、NVIDIA Kyber 800VDC構成向け15W・35W補助電源の参照設計を公開。技術対応でありNVIDIAの購入契約量ではない。FY2025の自社開示はSeiko Epsonを主要シリコンウエハー製造先の一社とし、契約期限を2035年12月と記載する。

en.business: Makes high-voltage chips that efficiently convert wall power into the direct current used by electronics, along with motor and GaN gate drivers.
en.revenue: Sells power-conversion ICs and driver products into appliances, chargers, industrial systems, renewable energy and automotive applications.
en.strength: Integrates high-voltage switches and control circuitry to reduce component count, energy loss and design time, supported by design tools and efficiency features.
en.risks: Appliance and consumer demand, channel inventory, China exposure, competition and outsourced manufacturing affect results; falling discrete-component prices can add pricing pressure.
en.competition: Power Integrations names STMicroelectronics and Infineon for high-voltage power ICs, and NXP and Texas Instruments among PWM-controller suppliers. onsemi is compared in motor-drive power modules. GaN, gate drivers and controllers serve different roles; discrete-component designs also remain alternatives.
en.relationships: Supplies appliance, industrial and automotive power designers directly and through distributors while outsourcing wafer fabrication, assembly and test. In June 2026 it published 15 W and 35 W auxiliary-power reference designs for NVIDIA Kyber 800 VDC, establishing technical compatibility rather than NVIDIA purchase volumes. Its FY2025 filing names Seiko Epson among major silicon-wafer foundries, with an agreement through December 2035.

en.strength: Integrates MEMS resonators, analog circuitry, packaging and software to deliver programmable timing resilient to vibration and temperature change.

It does not allocate undisclosed manufacturing volumes or every product to either foundry.

ja.business: 半導体の表面を撮影して欠陥を見つけ、微細な高さや寸法を測る検査・計測装置を作る会社。先端パッケージ、HBM、化合物半導体に強い。
ja.revenue: 半導体メーカーと組立・検査会社へ検査・計測装置を販売し、保守、部品、ソフトの継続収入も得る。
ja.strength: 一台で2D検査と3D計測を組み合わせ、量産速度を保ちながら複雑なパッケージの欠陥と高さを確認できる。
ja.risks: 設備投資の波、大口顧客、輸出規制、イスラエルの地政学、少数の製造委託先に左右される。装置認定の遅れも売上時期を動かす。
ja.competition: 先端パッケージなどの検査・計測ではOnto InnovationとKLA、計測の一部ではNovaが競合例。NovaはCamtekを実名で挙げている。OntoとKLAは両社の公表装置との比較で、欠陥検査と高さ・寸法計測を区別する。
ja.relationships: 半導体工場と組立・検査会社へ装置を供給し、外部メーカーから光学・機械・電子部品を調達して組み立てる。 自社FY2025年次報告書によると、台湾上場のChroma ATEは2026年3月5日現在でCamtek普通株の16.79%を保有。2019年に締結した三角測量プラットフォームのライセンスを含む技術協力契約も開示する。持分は基準日時点であり、新規の2026年出資と扱わない。

en.business: Makes inspection and metrology systems that image semiconductor surfaces to find defects and measure fine dimensions and height, with emphasis on advanced packaging, HBM and compound semiconductors.
en.revenue: Sells inspection and metrology systems to chipmakers and assembly-and-test providers, with recurring service, parts and software revenue.
en.strength: Combines high-throughput 2D inspection and 3D metrology to check defects and height across increasingly complex packages.
en.risks: Results depend on fab spending, large customers, export controls, Israeli geopolitical conditions and a limited supplier base; qualification delays can shift revenue timing.
en.competition: Examples include Onto Innovation and KLA in advanced-packaging inspection and metrology, and Nova in selected metrology applications. Nova explicitly names Camtek. Onto and KLA are editorial comparisons of disclosed tools, distinguishing defect inspection from dimensional and height measurement.
en.relationships: Supplies systems to wafer fabs and assembly-and-test providers and sources optical, mechanical and electronic components from external manufacturers. Its FY2025 annual report states that Taiwan-listed Chroma ATE held 16.79% of Camtek ordinary shares on March 5, 2026. It also discloses a 2019 technology-cooperation agreement including triangulation-platform licensing. The dated holding is not a new 2026 investment.

ja.business: 半導体の膜厚、寸法、材料組成を光やX線で測り、製造工程のずれを見つける計測装置と解析ソフトを作る会社。
ja.revenue: 半導体メーカーへの計測装置販売と、ソフト、保守、交換部品、既存装置の更新で稼ぐ。
ja.strength: 光学、X線、材料計測と機械学習解析を組み合わせ、微細化した工程や先端パッケージを非破壊で管理できる。
ja.risks: 少数の大口顧客、半導体設備投資、輸出規制、イスラエルの地政学、外部製造・部品供給に業績が左右される。
ja.competition: 寸法・薄膜・薬液の工程管理ではOnto InnovationとKLA、装置内の計測ではApplied Materials、ウエハーレベルのパッケージ計測などではCamtekとドイツのMerckが競合例。Nova自身が実名を挙げている。測る対象や工程が異なり、全装置を同じ用途とはみなさない。
ja.relationships: 半導体工場へ装置と解析ソフトを供給し、外部メーカーから光学、X線、電子、機械部品を調達する。

en.business: Makes metrology systems and analytics software that use optical and X-ray techniques to measure film thickness, dimensions and material composition in chip production.
en.revenue: Earns from metrology-system sales to semiconductor manufacturers plus software, service, spare parts and installed-base upgrades.
en.strength: Combines optical, X-ray and materials metrology with machine-learning analytics to control scaled processes and advanced packaging without damaging wafers.
en.risks: A few large customers, semiconductor capital spending, export controls, Israeli geopolitical conditions and outsourced components and manufacturing affect results.
en.competition: Nova names Onto Innovation and KLA in dimensional, thin-film and chemical process control; Applied Materials in in-situ metrology; and Camtek and Germany’s Merck in wafer-level packaging and specialty markets. These involve different measurements and process stages.
en.relationships: Supplies tools and analytics software to wafer fabs and sources optical, X-ray, electronic and mechanical components externally.

ja.business: 半導体ウエハーへイオンを打ち込み、電気特性を作り込むイオン注入装置を開発・製造する会社。
ja.revenue: 半導体工場へのPurion装置販売に加え、保守、部品、装置改造、訓練で稼ぐ。
ja.strength: 高電流から高エネルギーまで共通設計のPurionシリーズでカバーし、パワー半導体や成熟工程の量産にも対応する。
ja.risks: 設備投資と中国需要、大口顧客、輸出規制、長い認定期間、少数の重要部品供給元に左右される。
ja.competition: イオン注入装置ではApplied Materialsが主な競合。Axcelis自身は両社が一通りの注入方式を扱うと説明し、住友重機械イオンテクノロジーと日新イオン機器も実名で挙げている。注入エネルギーや電流、対象材料によって競合する装置は異なる。
ja.relationships: 半導体メーカーへイオン注入装置を供給し、磁石、電源、真空、制御部品を外部供給元から調達する。 FY2025自社年次報告書はSMICを主要な中国顧客の一社として実名開示。成熟プロセス工場向け装置の輸出許可を得てきたと説明しており、全用途の無制限な供給や匿名顧客の売上比率をSMICに割り当てることはできない。

en.business: Develops and manufactures ion-implantation systems that inject ions into wafers to set semiconductor electrical characteristics.
en.revenue: Earns from Purion system sales to wafer fabs plus service, spare parts, upgrades and training.
en.strength: Its common-platform Purion family spans high-current through high-energy implantation and serves high-volume power and mature-node production.
en.risks: Fab spending and China demand, large customers, export controls, long qualifications and limited sources for critical components affect results.
en.competition: Axcelis identifies Applied Materials as its main ion-implant competitor and also names Sumitomo Heavy Industries Ion Technology and Nissin Ion Equipment. Implant energy, current and wafer material determine which tools overlap.
en.relationships: Supplies implantation systems to semiconductor manufacturers and buys magnets, power, vacuum and control components from external suppliers. Its FY2025 annual report names SMIC as a major Chinese customer and describes licenses obtained for mature-process fabs. This does not establish unrestricted supply for every use or identify SMIC as any anonymous revenue-concentration figure.

ja.business: 完成した半導体を高速に検査するテスト装置、搬送装置、画像検査装置と、チップへ接触するソケットを作る会社。
ja.revenue: 半導体メーカーと組立・検査会社への装置販売、交換頻度の高いソケット・接触部品、保守と部品で稼ぐ。
ja.strength: テスター、ハンドラー、画像検査、接触部品をまとめて提供し、車載・産業・通信向けチップの量産工程を一式で支えられる。
ja.risks: 半導体の生産量と設備投資、大口顧客、買収統合、部品供給、価格競争、地政学と輸出規制に左右される。
ja.competition: 半導体テストではAdvantestとTeradyne、テスト時の搬送・自動化ではHon Precision、検査・計測ではKLAが競合例。Cohu自身が年次報告で実名を挙げている。テスター、搬送装置、検査装置、接触部品を同じ製品としては扱わない。
ja.relationships: 半導体メーカーと組立・検査会社へテスト工程の装置と消耗部品を供給し、電子・機械部品を外部から調達する。 FY2025年次報告書は、半導体テスト装置の大部分をマレーシアのJabil拠点に製造委託すると明記。製造受託先としての関係であり、CohuからJabilへの出資を示すものではない。

en.business: Makes semiconductor test systems, handlers, vision-inspection equipment and sockets that contact finished chips during high-volume testing.
en.revenue: Earns from equipment sales to chipmakers and OSATs, recurring sockets and contactors, service and spare parts.
en.strength: Combines testers, handlers, vision inspection and interface products to support complete production-test cells for automotive, industrial and communications chips.
en.risks: Semiconductor unit volume and capital spending, large customers, acquisition integration, component supply, pricing, geopolitics and export controls affect results.
en.competition: Cohu names Advantest, Teradyne, Hon Precision and KLA among its competitors. Examples span semiconductor testing, test automation, inspection and metrology. Testers, handlers, inspection tools and contact interfaces serve different functions.
en.relationships: Supplies production-test equipment and consumables to chipmakers and OSATs and sources electronic and mechanical components externally. Its FY2025 annual report identifies Jabil in Malaysia as the contract manufacturer for most semiconductor test systems. This manufacturing relationship does not establish an equity investment in Jabil.

ja.business: ウエハーから切り出した半導体を保護・接続するパッケージへ組み立て、動作を検査する受託会社。
ja.revenue: ファブレス企業、IDM、電子機器メーカーから、先端・従来型パッケージングとテストを請け負って稼ぐ。
ja.strength: フリップチップ、SiP、ファンアウト、2.5Dなど幅広い工程と世界各地の量産拠点を持ち、設計からテストまで対応できる。
ja.risks: 大口顧客とスマホ・車載需要、工場稼働率、巨額設備投資、地政学、素材・装置供給、顧客の内製化に左右される。
ja.competition: 半導体の組立・パッケージ・テスト受託ではASE Technology、JCET Group、Powertech Technologyが競合例。Amkor自身が年次報告に実名を記載している。先端パッケージ、従来型の組立、メモリーのテストなどで各社の得意分野は異なる。
ja.relationships: 半導体設計会社やIDMからチップを受け取り、外部の材料・装置会社を使って組立・検査し、完成品を顧客へ返す。 FY2025のApple・Qualcommへの直接売上は、それぞれ29.8%・11.1%。TSMCとは2026年6月に米国で先端包装・試験を調達する枠組みを含む10年協業契約を発表した。アリゾナの能力拡張は計画・建設中の範囲を含む。

en.business: Provides outsourced semiconductor packaging that protects and connects diced chips, then tests them for proper operation.
en.revenue: Earns by performing advanced and conventional packaging and test for fabless companies, IDMs and electronics manufacturers.
en.strength: Offers flip-chip, SiP, fan-out, 2.5D and other processes across a global manufacturing footprint, spanning package design through test.
en.risks: Large customers, handset and automotive demand, factory utilization, heavy capital spending, geopolitics, material and equipment supply and customer insourcing affect results.
en.competition: Amkor names ASE Technology, JCET Group and Powertech Technology as outsourced packaging and test competitors. Their emphasis differs across advanced packaging, conventional assembly and memory testing; they are not interchangeable across every service.
en.relationships: Receives chips from fabless companies and IDMs, uses materials and equipment suppliers to assemble and test them, and returns completed devices to customers. Direct sales to Apple and Qualcomm were 29.8% and 11.1% of FY2025 sales. A June 2026 ten-year TSMC agreement creates a US advanced-packaging and testing procurement framework; Arizona capacity expansion includes planned and developing facilities.

ja.business: 半導体の組立・パッケージ・テストに加え、電子機器の基板組立や完成品製造も受託する会社。

ja.strength: 世界最大級の生産規模と、先端パッケージ、テスト、基板・完成品組立を一社でつなげられる工程範囲が強み。
ja.risks: 半導体・電子機器需要、大口顧客、工場稼働率、設備投資、台湾海峡の地政学、為替、電力・水供給に左右される。

ja.relationships: 半導体会社から組立・テストを、電子機器ブランドから基板・完成品製造を受託し、材料・装置会社から生産資材を調達する。 Siemensは2025年9月、ASEのVIPack向けにInnovator3D ICを用いた3Dblox設計ワークフローの協業・検証を発表。上場親会社SiemensのEDA技術協力として表示し、工場装置の購入や出資とは区別する。

en.business: Provides semiconductor assembly, packaging and test plus electronics manufacturing services for circuit boards and finished devices.
en.revenue: Earns from semiconductor assembly-and-test operations and EMS for communications, computing, automotive and other electronics.
en.strength: Combines very large manufacturing scale with advanced packaging, test, board assembly and finished-product manufacturing under one group.
en.risks: Semiconductor and electronics demand, large customers, factory utilization, capital spending, Taiwan Strait geopolitics, currencies and power and water availability affect results.
en.competition: Examples include Amkor in outsourced semiconductor packaging and test, and Jabil and Flex in the electronics design and manufacturing services provided by ASE subsidiary USI. Amkor explicitly names ASE; the EMS examples are editorial comparisons of disclosed services, separate from chip packaging.
en.relationships: Performs packaging and test for chip companies and board and finished-product manufacturing for electronics brands, sourcing materials and equipment externally. en.business: Manufactures chips designed by other companies, focusing on differentiated RF, power, automotive and IoT processes rather than leading-edge scaling.

ja.relationships: 自動車・産業・電子機器メーカーへ半導体を供給し、外部の装置・材料会社と一部ファウンドリーを生産に利用する。 2026年2月の自社発表はAWSへの接続・マイコン・アナログ電源半導体の複数年供給を明記。AWS向け最大2,480万株のワラントは購入支払い等に連動して権利確定する条件付きで、全株式を取得済みとは扱わない。

en.strength: Spans MCUs, SiC power devices and MEMS sensors and combines design with internal fabs to support long automotive and industrial programs.
en.risks: Automotive and industrial demand and inventory, fab utilization, heavy capital spending, SiC demand, European and Asian manufacturing and export controls affect results.
en.competition: Examples include NXP in automotive MCUs, Infineon and Navitas in SiC power devices, and Analog Devices in MEMS inertial sensors. Navitas explicitly names ST; the other examples are editorial comparisons of official portfolios. These are separate product scopes, not whole-company equivalence.
en.relationships: Supplies chips to automotive, industrial and electronics manufacturers and uses equipment, material and selected external-foundry partners in production. A February 2026 release names AWS semiconductor supply across connectivity, MCUs and analog / power. Warrants for up to 24.8 million shares vest substantially with AWS purchases; the full amount is not assumed exercised or owned.

ja.strength: 低消費電力の音声処理、アンプ、電源・触覚制御を一つの機器向けに統合し、大量生産製品へ深く組み込まれる。

ja.relationships: 電子機器メーカーへ音声・制御用半導体を供給し、ウエハー製造、組立、検査は外部パートナーへ委託する。 FY2026のApple向けは製造受託会社を通じた最終顧客売上で約91%。主要ウエハー供給元はGlobalFoundriesとTSMC。GlobalFoundriesの能力予約・供給契約は暦年2026年までで、製造受託会社との直接売上をApple直接取引と混同しない。

en.business: Makes audio chips that process and amplify sound in smartphones and other devices plus high-performance mixed-signal chips for power and haptic control.
en.revenue: Sells semiconductors primarily to makers of smartphones, tablets, laptops, wearables and related devices.
en.strength: Integrates low-power audio processing, amplification, power and haptic control and becomes deeply designed into high-volume devices.
en.risks: Dependence on one major customer, smartphone sales, design-win changes, outsourced manufacturing, inventory and export controls affect results.
en.competition: Examples include AKM and Analog Devices in audio conversion and signal-processing ICs, and Texas Instruments in audio amplifiers and haptic drivers. Cirrus Logic names all three; product scopes are checked against official portfolios rather than inferred solely from the broad competitor list.
en.relationships: Supplies audio and control chips to device makers and outsources wafer fabrication, assembly and test. Apple was the end customer for about 91% of FY2026 net sales through contract manufacturers. Principal wafer suppliers include GlobalFoundries and TSMC; the GlobalFoundries reservation agreement runs through calendar 2026. End-customer attribution is distinct from direct invoicing.

ja.revenue: 家庭・産業IoT、企業向け機器、自動車、PC周辺機器メーカーへ半導体と関連ソフトを販売して稼ぐ。
ja.strength: 演算、無線接続、音声・映像、タッチを一つのIoT基盤へまとめ、機器メーカーの設計を簡単にできる。

en.revenue: Sells chips and related software to home and industrial IoT, enterprise-device, automotive and PC-peripheral manufacturers.
en.strength: Combines compute, wireless connectivity, audio and video and touch into IoT platforms that simplify device design.
en.risks: IoT and PC demand, large customers, distributor inventory, external foundries, product transitions, pricing and acquisition integration affect results.

ja.competition: 車載レーダーの半導体ではNXP、車載電源・充電制御ではMonolithic Power Systemsが競合例。indie自身の実名開示と各社の公式製品で範囲を照合した。ADASセンサーと車内の電源機能を分け、縮小中の低付加価値照明へ競争範囲を広げない。
ja.relationships: 自動車部品会社と車載システムメーカーへ半導体・ソフトを供給し、製造は外部ファウンドリーと組立会社へ委託する。 2025年3月、GlobalFoundriesの22FDXを使う77GHz・120GHzレーダーSoCの開発協業を発表。77GHzの設計採用段階や120GHzの初期サンプルを、全車種への量産採用完了とは扱わない。

en.business: A fabless supplier of ADAS radar, vision and lidar technologies plus automotive connectivity and power chips/software. It is reducing lower-value interior lighting and prioritizing sensing and software-enabled platforms.
en.revenue: Sells semiconductors to automotive suppliers and system makers and also earns development and engineering revenue.
en.strength: Combines automotive-grade sensing, preprocessing, connectivity and software and wins multi-year vehicle-platform designs.
en.risks: Many wins precede production, so delays or cancellations, ongoing losses and funding needs, acquisition integration, large customers and outsourced manufacturing affect results.
en.competition: NXP is an example in automotive radar chips and Monolithic Power Systems in automotive power/charging controls. indie explicitly names both; official products support the scoped overlap. ADAS sensing and in-cabin power are distinct, while lower-value interior lighting is being reduced.
en.relationships: Supplies chips and software to automotive suppliers and system manufacturers and outsources fabrication, assembly and test. A March 2025 announcement covers 77GHz / 120GHz radar-SoC collaboration on GlobalFoundries 22FDX. Design-in and initial samples are distinct from completed volume adoption across vehicles.

ja.risks: 小売・物流の導入速度、大口顧客、タグ価格、在庫変動、外部製造、無線規格、知的財産訴訟に左右される。
ja.competition: RAIN RFIDのタグ用ICではNXPとAlien Technology、読み取りICではPhychips、タグ試験・生産システムではCISC Semiconductorが競合例。Impinj自身が製品別に実名を記載している。読み取り機器の多くは同社基盤を利用するため、導入先を一律に競合扱いしない。
ja.relationships: タグ・ラベル会社へICを供給し、リーダー・ソフトのパートナーを通じて小売、物流、製造現場の物品を接続する。 自社の公式物流事例は、Avery DennisonがImpinjのRFIDタグIC・リーダーIC・リーダーを採用すると明記。製品採用先として表示し、現在の購入量や全物流事業者への直接売上を推測しない。

en.business: Makes RAIN RFID endpoint ICs, reader ICs, readers and software that wirelessly identify individual apparel items, parcels, parts and other objects.
en.revenue: Sells endpoint ICs to tag and label makers and reader products and cloud-related services to equipment makers and adopters.
en.strength: Provides tag-side and reader-side chips, devices and software as one platform that continuously reads data from very large populations of items.
en.risks: Retail and logistics adoption, large customers, tag pricing, inventory swings, outsourced manufacturing, radio standards and IP litigation affect results.
en.competition: Impinj names NXP and Alien Technology in endpoint/tag ICs, Phychips in reader ICs, and CISC Semiconductor in tag and production systems. Its filing separates these product areas and notes that many reader/gateway suppliers use its platform; customers are not automatically competitors.
en.relationships: Supplies ICs to tag and label companies and uses reader and software partners to connect items across retail, logistics and manufacturing. An official logistics case identifies Avery Dennison using Impinj tag ICs, reader ICs and readers. This establishes product adoption without current volumes or inferred direct sales to every logistics operator.

ja.business: 購入後に回路を書き換えられる低消費電力FPGAと、その設計ソフト・IPを作るファブレス半導体会社。

ja.strength: 小型・低消費電力のFPGAに集中し、機器の制御、接続、セキュリティ、エッジAI機能を短期間で変更できる。
ja.risks: 産業・通信需要、大口販売会社、在庫、外部ファウンドリー、製品世代交代、輸出規制、より大規模な競合に左右される。
ja.competition: 低消費電力・小中規模のFPGAではAMDのSpartan・Artix系、MicrochipのPolarFire、AlteraのMAX 10などが競合例。各社の公表製品を照合した編集上の比較。AlteraはSilver Lakeが過半数を取得した会社として表示し、Intelの現在の子会社や独立した上場銘柄としては扱わない。
ja.relationships: 機器メーカーへFPGA、設計ソフト、IPを供給し、ウエハー製造と組立・検査は外部会社へ委託する。 2026年3月にNVIDIA Halosエコシステム参加を発表し、Holoscan Sensor Bridgeを使う設計開発を計画。参加・開発協業を、全設計の安全認定取得済みやGPU購入契約と混同しない。

en.business: A fabless company making low-power FPGAs whose logic can be reprogrammed after purchase, together with design software and IP.
en.revenue: Sells FPGAs and provides software and IP to communications, industrial, automotive, computing and consumer-device makers.
en.strength: Focuses on small, low-power FPGAs that let customers quickly change control, connectivity, security and edge-AI functions.
en.risks: Industrial and communications demand, major distributors, inventory, external foundries, product transitions, export controls and larger rivals affect results.
en.competition: Examples in low-power and small/mid-range programmable logic include AMD Spartan/Artix families, Microchip PolarFire and Altera MAX 10. This is an editorial comparison of official products. Altera is majority-owned by Silver Lake, with Intel retaining a minority stake; no separate public ticker is assigned.
en.relationships: Supplies FPGAs, design software and IP to equipment makers and outsources wafer fabrication, assembly and test. The March 2026 release announces NVIDIA Halos ecosystem participation and planned Holoscan Sensor Bridge designs. Participation and development do not establish completed safety certification for every design or a GPU purchase contract.

ja.business: 半導体ウエハーの各チップへ微細な針で触れて電気検査するプローブカードと、精密計測・低温試験装置を作る会社。
ja.revenue: 半導体メーカーとテスト会社へプローブカード、計測システム、関連部品と保守を販売して稼ぐ。
ja.strength: 先端ロジック、DRAM・HBM、先端パッケージの微細な接点へ同時に触れ、量産前後の電気特性を高精度で測れる。
ja.risks: 半導体設備投資、大口顧客、メモリー市況、製品認定、複雑な製造歩留まり、買収統合、部品供給に左右される。
ja.competition: プローブカードではTechnoprobeとMicronics Japan、計測用プローブ・プローブステーションではMPI、温度制御ではAEM、極低温装置ではBlueforsが競合例。FormFactor自身が製品別に実名を挙げている。量産検査用の接触部品と研究・計測用装置は分けて比べる。
ja.relationships: 半導体工場とテスト会社へ検査用プローブカードと計測装置を供給し、精密部品・材料を外部から調達する。 FY2025の自社開示でSK hynix向け売上は22.9%。プローブカード等の顧客関係として表示する。顧客別の全製品内訳や将来の購入数量は示していない。

en.business: Makes probe cards whose fine contacts electrically test each die on a wafer plus precision measurement and cryogenic test systems.
en.revenue: Sells probe cards, measurement systems, related parts and service to semiconductor manufacturers and test providers.
en.strength: Contacts fine-pitch advanced logic, DRAM and HBM and advanced-packaging devices in parallel to measure electrical performance before and during production.
en.risks: Semiconductor capital spending, large customers, memory cycles, qualifications, complex manufacturing yield, acquisition integration and component supply affect results.
en.competition: FormFactor names Technoprobe and Micronics Japan in probe cards, MPI in analytical probes and probe stations, AEM in thermal subsystems, and Bluefors in cryogenic systems. Production-test contacts and laboratory measurement equipment are distinct markets.
en.relationships: Supplies test probe cards and measurement tools to wafer fabs and test providers and sources precision components and materials externally. FY2025 disclosure attributes 22.9% of sales to SK hynix, a customer for probe cards and related products. The filing does not provide a complete customer-specific product split or future purchase volumes.

ja.business: 半導体やディスプレーの回路パターンを製造工程へ転写する原版、フォトマスクを作る会社。

ja.relationships: 半導体・ディスプレーメーカーへフォトマスクを供給し、マスク原板、描画・検査装置を外部から調達する。 2026年8月2日期の自社開示で、大日本印刷との中国フォトマスク合弁PDMCXを確認。Photronicsは50.01%、大日本印刷側は49.99%を保有し、台湾・中国以外の競合関係と併存する。上場親会社の大日本印刷として表示する。

en.business: Makes photomasks, the master templates used to transfer circuit patterns during semiconductor and display manufacturing.
en.revenue: Earns revenue by selling application-specific photomasks to semiconductor and display manufacturers.
en.strength: Writes fine customer circuit data accurately onto large masks, qualifies with fabs and supports production on short delivery cycles.
en.risks: Semiconductor and display investment, large customers, costly equipment, yield, export controls and blank or tool supply affect results.
en.competition: Photronics names Tekscend Photomask, Dai Nippon Printing and SK-Electronics among photomask rivals. Its DNP competition statement excludes Taiwan and China. Semiconductor and display masks also differ in technology and demand.
en.relationships: Supplies photomasks to semiconductor and display makers and sources mask blanks plus writing and inspection equipment externally. The August 2, 2026 quarterly filing confirms the Chinese photomask venture PDMCX: Photronics holds 50.01% and the DNP side 49.99%. This coexists with competition outside Taiwan and China; the card represents listed parent Dai Nippon Printing.

ja.business: 電気を変換・制御するMOSFETなどの電力半導体と、電源管理ICを設計・供給する会社。
ja.revenue: PC、家電、通信、産業、自動車向けメーカーへ電力ディスクリートと電源管理ICを販売して稼ぐ。
ja.strength: 電力素子と制御ICの両方を持ち、用途ごとに損失・発熱・サイズを抑えた電源回路を提案できる。
ja.risks: PC・家電需要、販売価格の低下、顧客認定、製造歩留まり、製造委託先、品質事故や在庫調整に左右される。
ja.competition: MOSFETなどの電力ディスクリートではInfineon、onsemi、Vishay、電源管理ICではMonolithic Power Systems、Texas Instruments、onsemi、Vishayが競合例。AOS自身が両分野を分けて記載しており、電力素子と電源制御ICを区別する。
ja.relationships: OEM・設計製造会社へ電力半導体を直接または販売代理店経由で供給し、外部工場と組立検査会社も利用する。

en.business: Designs and supplies power semiconductors such as MOSFETs plus power-management integrated circuits.
en.revenue: Sells power discretes and power-management ICs into computing, consumer, communications, industrial and automotive equipment.
en.strength: Combines power devices and control ICs to tailor power circuits for lower loss, heat and size in each application.
en.risks: PC and consumer demand, price erosion, qualifications, manufacturing yield, outsourced capacity, quality events and inventory corrections affect results.
en.competition: AOS names Infineon, onsemi and Vishay among power-discrete competitors, and Monolithic Power Systems, Texas Instruments, onsemi and Vishay among power-IC competitors. Its filing separates power devices such as MOSFETs from the ICs that control power.
en.relationships: Supplies power semiconductors to OEMs and design manufacturers directly or through distributors and uses outside fabs and assembly-test providers.

ja.business: GaN電力IC、SiC電力半導体、制御ICを設計し、高効率な電力変換を支えるファブレス半導体会社。
ja.revenue: AIデータセンター、電力網、産業機器、太陽光・蓄電、充電器向けに電力半導体と制御製品を販売して稼ぐ。
ja.strength: 高速に切り替わるGaN、耐高電圧のSiC、制御・絶縁を組み合わせ、電源を小型化しながら変換損失を減らせる。
ja.risks: 高出力市場への移行、設計採用の獲得、赤字継続、製造委託先、量産品質、製品責任と輸出規制に左右される。
ja.competition: GaN電力半導体ではInfineonとPower Integrations、SiCではInfineon、onsemi、STMicroelectronics、シリコン電源製品ではこの4社などが競合例。Navitas自身の実名開示に基づく。GaN、SiC、シリコンは耐圧や用途が異なり、すべてを同一製品として比較しない。
ja.relationships: データセンター・エネルギー・産業機器メーカーへ電力半導体を供給し、ウエハー製造と組立検査を外部へ委託する。 2025年10月、NVIDIAの800VDC電源構成に対応するGaN・SiCデバイスの開発進捗を公表。参照構成への技術対応であり、NVIDIAによる直接購入・出資、全AIデータセンターでの採用完了とは扱わない。

en.business: A fabless semiconductor company designing GaN power ICs, SiC power devices and controllers for efficient power conversion.
en.revenue: Sells power semiconductors and controls for AI data centers, grids, industrial systems, solar and storage, and chargers.
en.strength: Combines fast-switching GaN, high-voltage SiC and control or isolation to shrink power systems while reducing conversion loss.
en.risks: The shift to high-power markets, design wins, continued losses, outsourced manufacturing, production quality, liability and export controls affect results.
en.competition: Navitas explicitly names Infineon and Power Integrations in GaN competition, Infineon, onsemi and STMicroelectronics in SiC, and all four in silicon-based power products. GaN, SiC and silicon alternatives differ in voltage and application; the examples are scoped rather than interchangeable products.
en.relationships: Supplies power devices to data-center, energy and industrial-equipment makers while outsourcing wafer fabrication and assembly-test. In October 2025 it announced development progress on GaN and SiC devices for NVIDIA’s 800 VDC power architecture. Technical support for that architecture does not establish direct NVIDIA purchases, investment or completed deployment across all AI data centers.

ja.business: 金属の切断・溶接・加工などに使う高出力ファイバーレーザー、増幅器、レーザー装置を作る会社。
ja.revenue: 産業機械メーカー、システム会社、製造業へレーザー光源・装置・部品と保守を販売して稼ぐ。
ja.strength: ダイオード、光ファイバー、光学部品まで主要部品を垂直統合し、高出力・高効率・長寿命の光源を作れる。
ja.risks: 中国を含む産業設備投資、販売価格の低下、顧客の内製、輸出規制、部材、工場稼働率と技術転換に左右される。
ja.competition: 材料加工向けレーザーではCoherent（COHR）やLumentum（LITE）などと競合する。IPGの年次報告は両社を実名で列挙している。競争は出力、加工品質、価格などで起こり、顧客によるレーザーの内製化もリスクになる。
ja.relationships: 機械メーカー、システムインテグレーター、製造業へレーザーを供給し、電子部品や原材料を外部調達する。 公式FlexCellのアーク溶接構成ではESABの電源・トーチ等を標準選択肢として掲載。製品構成上の対応であり、全装置にESAB製品が必須とはせず、地域による提供差や個別仕様を保持する。

en.business: Makes high-power fiber lasers, amplifiers and laser systems used for cutting, welding and other material processing.
en.revenue: Sells laser sources, systems, parts and service to industrial equipment makers, integrators and manufacturers.
en.strength: Vertically integrates key diodes, fibers and optics to build high-power, efficient and long-life laser sources.
en.risks: Industrial investment including China, price erosion, customer insourcing, export controls, materials, utilization and technology shifts affect results.
en.competition: Coherent (COHR) and Lumentum (LITE) are among the companies explicitly listed as competitors in materials-processing lasers in IPG’s annual report. Competition involves output power, processing quality and price. Customers developing their own lasers can also reduce the available market.
en.relationships: Supplies lasers to machine builders, system integrators and manufacturers and sources electronics and raw materials externally. Official FlexCell arc-welding specifications list ESAB power sources, torches and other standard options. This is configuration compatibility, without requiring ESAB equipment in every system; availability varies by region and configuration.

ja.business: 通信網の試験・監視装置、測位・時刻同期、紙幣や光学製品向けの特殊光学部材を作る会社。
ja.revenue: 通信会社、ネットワーク機器・データセンター、航空宇宙防衛、偽造防止・ディスプレー市場へ製品とソフトを販売して稼ぐ。
ja.strength: 高速通信を現場から研究所まで測る技術と、精密な光学・色制御、測位・時刻技術を複数市場へ展開できる。
ja.risks: 通信設備投資、顧客集中、買収統合、政府予算、部品供給、製品移行、輸出規制と工場稼働率に左右される。
ja.competition: 通信網の試験・監視ではKeysightとAnritsu、紙幣などの偽造防止技術ではCrane NXT、受動光部品ではCoherentが競合例。VIAVI自身の開示を製品別に整理しており、通信計測と特殊光学部材を同じ市場として扱わない。
ja.relationships: 通信・データセンター、航空宇宙防衛、偽造防止・表示機器会社へ測定装置や光学部材を供給し、電子・光学部品を調達する。 2026年3月の自社記事はNVIDIAとのAI-RAN試験・シミュレーションの共同デモを発表。TM500やTeraVMとNVIDIA基盤を組み合わせる技術協力で、NVIDIAからの調達量やVIAVIへの出資を示すものではない。

en.business: Makes network test and assurance tools, positioning and timing products, and specialty optics for security and display uses.
en.revenue: Sells hardware and software to telecom, network and data-center, aerospace-defense, anti-counterfeit and display markets.
en.strength: Combines field-to-lab high-speed network measurement with precision optical, color, positioning and timing technologies across markets.
en.risks: Telecom spending, customer concentration, acquisition integration, government budgets, components, transitions, export controls and utilization affect results.
en.competition: VIAVI names Keysight and Anritsu in network test and monitoring, Crane NXT in anti-counterfeiting technologies, and Coherent in passive optical components. These examples separate network measurement from optical security and components; they are not an exhaustive list.
en.relationships: Supplies test systems and optics to communications, data-center, defense and secure-document or display customers and sources optical-electronic parts. A March 2026 company article announces NVIDIA joint AI-RAN test and simulation demonstrations using TM500 / TeraVM and NVIDIA platforms. This is technical collaboration without inferred procurement volumes or investment.

ja.business: 光ファイバー、ディスプレー用ガラス、スマホ向けカバーガラス、排ガス浄化用セラミックなどを作る材料会社。
ja.revenue: 通信網・データセンター、ディスプレー・端末、自動車、研究・医療向けにガラス、光通信部材、セラミック製品を販売して稼ぐ。

ja.risks: 大口顧客、通信・ディスプレー需要、価格交渉、エネルギー・原材料、工場稼働率、為替と設備投資に左右される。
ja.competition: 光通信ではAmphenol、表示ガラスではAGCや日本電気硝子、排ガス浄化用セラミックではNGK、研究・医療用製品ではThermo FisherやDanaherが競合例。Corningの年次報告が分野別に実名で列挙している。旧・日本ガイシは2026年にNGKへ改称した。
ja.relationships: 通信・データセンター、端末・表示、自動車・研究機器会社へ材料と部品を供給し、原材料と製造装置を調達する。 CorningとMetaは2026年1月、米国データセンター向け光ファイバー・ケーブル・接続製品を複数年で最大60億ドル供給する契約を共同発表。金額は上限であり売上実績ではなく、生産能力拡張も完了済みと断定しない。

en.business: Makes optical fiber, display glass, device cover glass and ceramic substrates used for emissions control and other applications.
en.revenue: Sells glass, optical-connectivity and ceramic products into networks and data centers, displays and devices, automotive and life sciences.
en.strength: Combines glass, ceramic and optical materials science with proprietary processes to mass-produce demanding customer-specific components.
en.risks: Large customers, network and display demand, pricing, energy and raw materials, utilization, currency and capital investment affect results.
en.competition: Corning names Amphenol in optical communications, AGC and Nippon Electric Glass in display glass, NGK in automotive ceramics, and Thermo Fisher and Danaher in life sciences. Its filing uses NGK’s former name, NGK Insulators; the company renamed itself NGK Corporation in 2026.
en.relationships: Supplies materials and components to network, device, display, auto and life-science customers and sources raw materials and production equipment. Corning and Meta jointly announced a multiyear agreement in January 2026 for up to $6 billion of optical fiber, cable and connectivity for US data centers. The ceiling is not realized revenue, and announced capacity expansion is not assumed complete.

ja.risks: 半導体サイクル、在庫評価損、仕入先契約、価格下落、顧客信用、運転資金、物流と地政学に左右される。
ja.competition: 電子部品の量産向け流通ではArrow Electronics、Farnellの少量・短納期販売ではMouser、Digi-Key、RSが競合例。Avnet自身が年次報告で実名を挙げている。量産調達と試作・小口の通販では顧客の用途や必要なサービスが異なる。
ja.relationships: 半導体・電子部品メーカーから仕入れ、OEM・受託製造会社・技術者へ部品、設計、供給網サービスを提供する。 Avnet Integratedの公式ページはAMDを供給パートナーとして挙げ、EPYCサーバーCPUを用いる設計・統合を支援。製品供給・設計支援の関係で、特定顧客の購入数量や独占性は未開示。

en.business: A technology distributor sourcing semiconductors, interconnect, passive and embedded products and selling them with design and procurement support.
en.revenue: Sells components and embedded products to OEMs, contract manufacturers and engineers and provides inventory, logistics and design services.
en.strength: Combines a global production supply chain with Farnell's small-order, quick-delivery channel to support customers from prototype to volume.
en.risks: Semiconductor cycles, inventory write-downs, supplier agreements, price declines, customer credit, working capital, logistics and geopolitics affect results.
en.competition: Avnet names Arrow Electronics in production component distribution and Mouser, Digi-Key and RS among Farnell’s high-service distribution competitors. Volume sourcing differs from prototype and small-order online procurement.
en.relationships: Sources from semiconductor and component makers and provides parts, design help and supply-chain services to OEMs, manufacturers and engineers. Avnet Integrated names AMD as a supplier partner and supports designs and integration using EPYC server CPUs. This identifies product supply and design support, without customer-specific purchase volumes or exclusivity.

en.revenue: Earns manufacturing-service revenue from industrial and energy, medical, defense, auto, communications and cloud-AI customers.
en.strength: Supports complex high-reliability products across design, component fabrication, assembly, test, supply chain and repair.
en.risks: Large customers and order changes, thin margins, utilization, shortages, quality, tariffs and regulated-market qualifications affect results.
en.competition: Sanmina names Jabil, Flex and Benchmark Electronics among its electronics manufacturing competitors. Medical, communications and cloud products require different technologies and qualifications, so competition differs by program.
en.relationships: Provides design and manufacturing to equipment companies and sources semiconductors, electronic components, metals and resins. Nokia announced in April 2024 that Buy America-compliant optical-access OLT cards had entered production at Sanmina in Wisconsin. This identifies the announced US products, without establishing current worldwide production volumes.

ja.risks: 値下げ競争と需要変動、新型車・自動運転の開発、工場増産、電池材料、規制やブランドへの影響に左右される。

en.business: Designs and manufactures electric vehicles and battery storage, supported by charging, service, insurance and solar offerings.
en.revenue: Vehicle sales and leases, regulatory credits, battery and solar products, plus charging, service and other activities.
en.strength: Integrates vehicles, batteries, power electronics, software, factories, direct sales and a fast-charging network.
en.risks: Pricing and demand, new-product and autonomy execution, factory ramps, battery materials, regulation and brand effects drive risk.
en.competition: Passenger-EV examples are Ford Mustang Mach-E, GM Chevrolet Equinox EV/Blazer EV and BYD SEALION 7. Storage examples separately compare Fluence Gridstack at utility scale and Enphase IQ Battery at home scale. These editorial comparisons use official products; vehicle availability, use cases and storage scale/performance are not assumed identical.
en.relationships: Tesla’s FY2025 filing names Panasonic and CATL as battery-cell suppliers. Panasonic is represented through Tokyo-listed Panasonic Holdings (6752) and its Energy business; CATL is Hong Kong listed as 3750. The disclosure does not establish per-model supply shares, total current procurement or exclusivity.

ja.business: 電磁場でイオンを閉じ込めて計算する量子コンピューターを開発し、量子ネットワークやセンシングにも広げる会社。
ja.revenue: 量子計算機へのクラウドアクセス、専用システム、研究開発契約、保守・専門サービスで稼ぐ。
ja.strength: 同じ種類の原子を量子ビットに使うためばらつきが小さく、計算機から制御ソフトまで一体で開発できる。
ja.risks: 市場が初期段階で赤字が続き、性能向上、量産、部品調達、人材、政府・大口案件の時期に左右される。
ja.competition: イオントラップ型ではQuantinuum、超伝導ゲート型ではIBM、Google、Rigettiが競合例。IonQの年次報告は各方式と企業名を挙げている。計算機の方式・利用環境が異なるため、量子ビット数だけで性能を同一視しない。
ja.relationships: 企業、大学、研究機関、政府へ量子計算環境と開発支援を提供し、レーザー・光学・真空など専門部品を調達する。 公式クラウド窓口はAmazon Braket、Microsoft Azure、Google CloudをIonQシステムの利用経路として掲載。クラウド経由の提供提携であり、各社の計算容量購入契約・投資額や全機種の常時利用可能性を推定しない。Googleの自社量子計算との競争は併存する。

en.business: Develops trapped-ion quantum computers and is expanding into quantum networking and sensing.
en.revenue: Cloud access, dedicated systems, research contracts, maintenance and professional services.
en.strength: Uses identical atomic ions for consistent qubits and develops the system, controls and software as an integrated stack.
en.risks: An early market, continuing losses, performance and scale-up goals, specialized supply, talent and contract timing create risk.
en.competition: IonQ names Quantinuum in trapped-ion computing and IBM, Google and Rigetti in superconducting gate-model computing. These are architecture-specific examples, not equivalent performance claims based on qubit counts.
en.relationships: Provides quantum access and development support to enterprises, researchers and governments while sourcing lasers, optics and vacuum components. Its cloud-access page lists Amazon Braket, Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud as routes to IonQ systems. Distribution/access partnerships do not establish capacity-purchase contracts, investment amounts or continuous availability of every device. Google’s own quantum-hardware competition coexists with this role.

ja.business: 超伝導回路を使うゲート型量子コンピューターを設計し、量子チップ、制御系、クラウド利用環境まで作る会社。
ja.revenue: クラウド経由の計算利用、量子チップとシステムの販売、政府・研究機関との開発契約で稼ぐ。
ja.strength: 量子チップを自社施設で製造し、高速ゲート、複数チップ接続、制御ソフトを一体で改善できる。
ja.risks: 実用上の優位性はまだ確立せず、誤り率と拡張性、赤字と資金、政府案件、極低温部品に左右される。
ja.competition: ゲート型量子計算機ではIBMとGoogleの超伝導方式、IonQとQuantinuumのイオントラップ方式が競合例。Rigetti自身の実名開示と各社の方式を照合した。クラウドで利用できることと、そのクラウド会社が計算機を製造することは区別する。
ja.relationships: 政府研究所、大学、企業へ量子計算機と研究支援を提供し、極低温・電子制御・製造材料を調達する。 公式利用窓口にAmazon Braket経由のRigetti量子システムを掲載。利用経路の提携でありAWSからの半導体調達や専用容量購入とは区別する。異なる量子方式が同等性能と示されたわけではない。

en.business: Builds gate-model quantum computers using superconducting circuits, spanning chips, controls and cloud access.
en.revenue: Cloud computing access, QPU and system sales, and development contracts with governments and research institutions.
en.strength: Fabricates chips in-house and can co-develop fast gates, multi-chip scaling, controls and software.
en.risks: Practical advantage is unproven; error rates, scaling, losses, funding, government work and cryogenic supply create risk.
en.competition: Rigetti names IBM and Google, which develop superconducting systems, and IonQ and Quantinuum, which use trapped ions, as computing competitors. Hardware development is distinct from cloud distribution, and different architectures are not treated as interchangeable.
en.relationships: Provides systems and research support to government labs, universities and enterprises and sources cryogenic and control components. Its official access page lists Rigetti systems through Amazon Braket. This is a distribution/access partnership, distinct from chip procurement from AWS or an AWS dedicated-capacity purchase. It does not establish equivalent performance across different quantum architectures.

ja.risks: 市場が初期段階で赤字が続き、採用速度、システム販売時期、技術ロードマップ、資金と部品に左右される。
ja.competition: D-WaveはIBM、Google、Quantinuumなどを量子計算市場の競合として開示している。IBM・Googleの超伝導ゲート型とQuantinuumのイオントラップ型は、同社のAdvantage2アニーリング機とは方式が異なる。計算需要や研究予算で競う例であり、同じ最適化問題で同等の製品だとは断定しない。
ja.relationships: 企業、政府、研究機関へクラウド利用と導入支援を提供し、極低温・電子制御部品を調達する。 2026年8月の共同発表は、NTT傘下DOCOMOがD-Waveを使う2件目のネットワーク最適化を本番導入したと説明。上場親会社NTT（東証9432）で表示し、DOCOMOの旧上場銘柄を復活させない。実装事例の成果を全ネットワーク・全量子方式に一般化しない。

en.business: Provides quantum-annealing systems and cloud tools for combinatorial optimization while developing gate-model technology.
en.revenue: Leap cloud subscriptions, professional services and training, system sales and maintenance; system revenue can be lumpy.
en.strength: Combines annealing hardware, hybrid solvers and developer tools aimed at applied optimization workloads.
en.risks: An early market, continuing losses, adoption, irregular system sales, roadmap execution, funding and components create risk.
en.competition: D-Wave names IBM, Google and Quantinuum among quantum-computing competitors. Their gate-model systems differ from Advantage2 annealing: they compete for computing demand and research budgets, without implying identical optimization capabilities or performance.
en.relationships: Provides cloud access and implementation support to enterprises, governments and researchers and sources cryogenic and control equipment. An August 2026 joint release describes NTT subsidiary DOCOMO deploying a second production network-optimization application using D-Wave. The card identifies listed parent NTT (Tokyo 9432), without reviving DOCOMO’s former listing. Case-specific results do not generalize to all networks or quantum architectures.

ja.business: 光を使う量子・光学システムと薄膜ニオブ酸リチウムの光集積回路を開発し、製造設備も持つ会社。
ja.revenue: 研究・専門サービス、光学製品、量子最適化機Diracのクラウド利用、光集積回路の製品・製造サービスで稼ぐ段階。
ja.strength: 室温で動く光学方式、光集積回路の設計、チップ製造設備を組み合わせて試作から製品まで進められる。
ja.risks: 2025年売上は小さく、赤字と資金需要、製品化と顧客獲得、工場立ち上げ、競合の豊富な資金に左右される。
ja.competition: Diracなどの量子・光学計算ではD-WaveのAdvantage2、IBMのゲート型計算機、Xanaduの光量子計算機Auroraが競合・代替方式の例。同社の実名開示と公式製品で範囲を確認した。光を使う方式でも設計と用途は異なり、これらを薄膜ニオブ酸リチウムの製造受託会社だとは扱わない。
ja.relationships: 企業・政府・研究機関へ製品と開発支援を提供し、光学・半導体材料や製造装置を調達する。 2026年3月、CienaとOFCで量子鍵配送（QKD）・量子認証・光暗号の共同実演を発表。通信セキュリティの技術協力であり、汎用量子計算性能の同等性、確定販売量、全顧客への提供完了は示していない。

en.business: Develops photonic quantum and sensing systems plus thin-film lithium-niobate photonic integrated circuits with in-house fabrication.
en.revenue: Early revenue comes from research services, optical products, cloud access to Dirac optimization systems and photonic products and foundry work.
en.strength: Combines room-temperature photonics, integrated-circuit design and chip fabrication from prototype through product development.
en.risks: Revenue remains small; losses, funding, commercialization, customer adoption, foundry ramp and better-funded rivals create risk.
en.competition: QCi names D-Wave, IBM and Xanadu among computing competitors. Examples include Advantage2 annealing, IBM gate-model systems and Xanadu Aurora photonic computing, checked against official products. Their architectures and applications differ; none is inferred to be a thin-film lithium-niobate foundry rival.
en.relationships: Provides products and development work to enterprise, government and research users and sources optical materials and fabrication equipment. In March 2026 QCi and Ciena announced an OFC demonstration combining QKD, quantum authentication and optical encryption. This is communications-security collaboration, without establishing equivalent general-purpose quantum performance, a sales volume or completed rollout to all customers.

ja.business: 小型ロケットElectronの打ち上げと、衛星・部品・運用ソフトを提供する宇宙会社。大型のNeutronは開発中。
ja.revenue: 打ち上げサービスと、衛星本体、太陽電池、姿勢制御・通信部品、宇宙機の製造・運用で稼ぐ。
ja.strength: ロケット、発射場、衛星、主要部品、軌道上運用を一社でつなぎ、任務全体をまとめて提供できる。
ja.risks: 打ち上げ失敗や延期、Neutron開発費、政府案件への依存、工場増産、部品・規制に左右される。
ja.competition: 打ち上げではSpaceXのFalcon 9とFireflyのAlpha、宇宙機ではNorthrop Grumman、宇宙機部品ではRedwireが競合例。Rocket Lab自身が分野別に実名を開示している。機体規模や相乗り・専用打ち上げの条件、部品の用途を区別して見る。 LUNR傘下Lanterisの年次報告は、国防・国家安全保障向け宇宙機製造の競合にRocket Labを明記する。LUNRの月面着陸サービスすべてと同じ事業という意味ではない。
ja.relationships: 政府・商業宇宙事業者へ打ち上げ、衛星、部品を提供する。Planet（PL）は2025年年次報告に打ち上げ顧客として実名開示される。これは公表済みの打ち上げ実績で、将来の全衛星を受注したという意味ではない。材料・電子・推進部品は航空宇宙関連の供給会社から調達する。

en.business: Provides Electron small-rocket launches and spacecraft, components and operations software; the larger Neutron remains in development.
en.revenue: Launch services and sales of spacecraft, solar power, attitude-control and communications components, manufacturing and operations.
en.strength: Connects rockets, launch sites, spacecraft, key components and on-orbit operations into an end-to-end mission offering.
en.risks: Launch failures or delays, Neutron development cost, government exposure, production ramps, components and regulation create risk.
en.competition: Rocket Lab names SpaceX and Firefly in launch, Northrop Grumman in spacecraft and Redwire in components. Falcon 9 rideshare/dedicated launches and Alpha serve different payload needs; spacecraft and component competition is a separate scope. LUNR identifies Rocket Lab as a competitor to its Lanteris business in defense/national-security spacecraft manufacturing, not as an equivalent across all lunar-landing services.
en.relationships: Provides launches, spacecraft and components to government and commercial users. Its FY2025 annual filing names Planet (PL) as a launch customer. This records disclosed past launches, not an award for all future Planet satellites. Aerospace suppliers provide materials, electronics and propulsion components.

ja.strength: 端末に専用機器を追加せず、携帯会社の周波数と顧客基盤を使って圏外地域を補完する設計。
ja.risks: 衛星配備に多額の資金が必要で、打ち上げ、技術性能、周波数・各国認可、通信会社との契約に左右される。

ja.relationships: 携帯通信会社とサービスを組み、利用者へ提供する。衛星部品、製造設備、打ち上げサービスを外部調達する。 公式提携先ページでAT&T、Verizon、Vodafoneを実名で確認。衛星と携帯網の統合に向けた技術・検証・商業協力であり、全地域の常時サービス提供完了や全契約量とは区別する。提携先一覧だけから各社の現時点の株式保有を推定しない。

en.business: Is building a satellite cellular network designed to connect ordinary smartphones directly, deploying its large BlueBird satellites in stages.
en.revenue: Is beginning to monetize satellite service through mobile operators, government work, equipment and development services.
en.strength: Uses mobile operators' spectrum and customer reach without requiring a special device, extending coverage beyond terrestrial networks.
en.risks: Capital needs, launches, technical performance, spectrum and country approvals, and definitive operator agreements drive risk.
en.competition: Examples for off-grid handset connectivity are SpaceX Starlink direct-to-cell and Globalstar handset satellite services. This editorial comparison of official disclosures distinguishes messaging/SOS from broadband. Globalstar’s agreed Amazon transaction is pending, not treated as completed.
en.relationships: Works with mobile-network operators to reach subscribers and sources satellite components, production equipment and launch services. Its partner page explicitly identifies AT&T, Verizon and Vodafone for technical, validation and commercial cooperation on satellite/mobile integration. Partnerships do not establish continuous service in every region or disclosed volumes. The directory alone does not establish each company’s current shareholding.

ja.risks: 契約更新、政府予算、衛星・打ち上げ失敗、画像性能、競争、赤字と継続投資に左右される。

ja.relationships: 政府、防衛、農業、地図、保険などへ画像・分析を提供し、打ち上げと衛星部品を外部から調達する。 2026年3月、NVIDIAとGPUによる衛星画像処理、CorrDiffによる画像高度化、AI検索用埋め込みを共同開発すると発表。Blackwell・IGX Thor等の技術利用を説明するが、全計画の提供完了、NVIDIAの画像購入や株式投資は推定しない。

en.business: Operates fleets of small satellites to repeatedly image Earth and provide imagery, change data and analytics software.
en.revenue: Contracts for imagery and data platforms, analytics, dedicated satellites and related services for governments and businesses.
en.strength: Combines frequent collection with a long image archive, making geographic change easier to compare over time.
en.risks: Renewals, government budgets, satellite or launch failures, image performance, competition, losses and continued investment create risk.
en.competition: Examples in optical imagery and tasking are Vantor WorldView, Airbus Pleiades Neo and BlackSky Gen-3/Spectra. This editorial comparison of official products does not imply equal resolution, revisit or analytics. Vantor is the current name of former Maxar Intelligence, without an obsolete public ticker.
en.relationships: Provides imagery and analytics to government, defense, agriculture, mapping and insurance users and sources launches and satellite components. In March 2026 Planet announced NVIDIA collaboration on GPU imagery processing, CorrDiff enhancement and embeddings for AI search. The use of Blackwell and IGX Thor technology does not establish completed delivery of all plans, NVIDIA imagery purchases or an equity investment.

ja.relationships: 米国政府と同盟国へ製品・開発・保守を提供し、航空電子、推進、通信、複合材料を調達する。 FY2024報告は、L3HarrisとCorvidが共同開発したShrykeをVAPOR 55 MXから投下する実証を記載。L3Harrisカードはこの時点・ペイロード対応に限定し、現在の購入量・独占契約や全機種への搭載とは扱わない。

en.strength: Integrates small drones, strike and counter-drone systems, command software, space and RF capabilities for operational missions.
en.risks: Budgets and award timing, product performance, security and export rules, production, supply and acquisition integration create risk.
en.competition: Examples include Redwire/Edge Autonomy Stalker and Penguin in small UAS and Anduril Roadrunner and RTX Coyote in counter-UAS. AeroVironment names these firms in the relevant categories; product evidence supports the scope. Small ISR aircraft, loitering munitions and interceptors are distinct.

Its FY2024 report describes a VAPOR 55 MX release demonstration using Shryke payloads co-developed by L3Harris and Corvid. The L3Harris card is limited to that dated payload integration, without asserting current volumes, exclusivity or adoption across every aircraft.

ja.competition: 戦術用無人ジェットではAndurilのFuryとGeneral AtomicsのAvenger・協働機開発、衛星地上管制ではL3HarrisのInControlが競合例。Kratosの実名開示と公式製品を照合した。防衛案件では企業同士が別の案件で提携する場合もあり、競合から取引関係を推測しない。

en.revenue: Government Solutions and Unmanned Systems earn mainly from U.S. government product sales and fixed-price and cost-plus contracts.
en.strength: Combines relatively affordable, producible drones and targets with propulsion and RF technologies for rapid defense experimentation.
en.risks: U.S. budgets and procurement, contract margins, testing and production, clearances, talent, parts and acquisition integration create risk.
en.competition: Examples include Anduril Fury and General Atomics Avenger/CCA development in tactical autonomous jets, and L3Harris InControl in satellite ground control. Kratos names these firms; official products support the scopes. Firms may team on other programs, so rivalry does not establish a commercial relationship.
en.relationships: Provides products and technology to U.S. government, allied and prime-contractor customers and sources aerospace and electronic components. On October 12, 2026 Kratos and Airbus announced the U740 Valkyrie’s first European flight. This is cooperation integrating the Kratos airframe with Airbus MARS and other systems; operational capability targeted for 2029 is not treated as delivered capability or a disclosed order volume.
